thread:
sam: Heads-up 1: customer asks to move from Pro -> Pro+ but only wants the throughput addon for a single endpoint. Need to decide packaging and contract language.
dina: Product stance: avoid per-endpoint permanent SKUs at launch. Offer 'endpoint reservation' as pilot with explicit aggregation rules.
jorge: Engineering: can implement endpoint tags and reservations, but it creates fragmentation in autoscaler and reporting.
carol: Sales wants a clean buy flow. They suggested a 3-month term for endpoint reservations to reduce churn.
sales-ops: Recommend: expose two purchase modes in catalog: 1) Addon - Tenant-wide (default), 2) Endpoint Reserve (pilot, limited customers).
billing-bot: Draft SKU: THRU-ADDON-STD (tenant-wide) price = $1200/mo. Endpoint pilot sku = THRU-ENDP-PILOT price = $1600/mo (3mo min).

sam: Contract constraints: if endpoint moves across routes later, we need a clause that reservations follow the logical endpoint id not URL. sales-ops: we'll add mapping clause.
dina: Launch gating: need - Billing export shows endpoint metadata - Usage aggregation test passing - 2 paying pilot customers signed - Messaging/FAQ for sales
jorge: Implementation notes:
```
# tokens counting
billing_key = f"tenant:{tid}:reserve:{reserve_id}"
agg_window = 24h
allow_borrow = true  # fallback to tenant pool when idle
```
carol: Borrow rules are important. Sales will not accept wasted capacity. Proposal: allow borrowing after 1h idle, with preemption if reserved usage spikes.
sam: Pricing principle: endpoint reservations price >= tenant-wide because of fragmentation and ops overhead. Also require min commitment to compensate.
sales-ops: Suggest add-on discounting: 10% for annual pay, no stacking with other promos.
billing-bot: Note: trials must be explicit. If we grant trial credits, flag invoices with TRIAL-THRU annotation.
dina: Decision (tentative): ship tenant-wide throughput addon broadly. Offer endpoint reservation as 3-month pilot SKU to selected customers with borrowing/backfill rules. Need sales one-pager + contract clause.
jorge: Action items: @jorge prototype tagging & billing export (ETA 2w), @carol prepare sales one-pager + contract snippet (ETA 3d), @sam draft pilot acceptance criteria (ETA 5d), @billing-bot create SKU entries and test invoice sample.
carol: I'll coordinate pilot customer signatures and collect use cases. :+1:
sam: Thanks all. I'll post a short summary to product board and spin up the pilot tracker.
